contract: Persist timestamps as pinned UTC spellings and JSON milliseconds/null; JSON columns remain TEXT with unknown/malformed text retained until changed; nullable bools, link-row ordering, trigger-maintained derived columns, rollback journal and transaction failure preserve upstream row meaning.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.

force is not applicable: persisted column semantics expose no force or override operation; upstream writers only create, update and reject values (server/models/MediaProgress.js:190-245, server/models/Book.js:440-487, server/objects/settings/ServerSettings.js:365-381).

Malformed JSON text inside a JSON column is not asserted against upstream: Sequelize parses JSON columns with a bare JSON.parse on read (node_modules/sequelize/lib/dialects/sqlite/data-types.js), so unknown-but-valid JSON fields are the retained-until-changed surface upstream tolerates; the scenario asserts unknown fields survive boot and rewritten writes.

invariants.contract: Persist timestamps as pinned UTC spellings and JSON milliseconds/null; JSON columns remain TEXT with unknown/malformed text retained until changed; nullable bools, link-row ordering, trigger-maintained derived columns, rollback journal and transaction failure preserve upstream row meaning.
